summary: Implemented pure update diff classification in src/lifecycle/diff.ts with no-op/config-only/rebuild outcomes, rebuild overrides for repo/ref/local-path and --rebuild, safe handling of unknown differences, missing state, missing/stopped/unhealthy containers, image drift, and secret changes without value leakage. Added 38 focused tests. Typecheck, lint, full 567-test suite, build, and the declared focused tests pass.

Added 38 focused tests. Typecheck, lint, full 567-test suite, build, and the declared focused tests pass.
decisions: A missing state.json or a state with no current image is treated as an unknown difference and rebuilt, so deleting the cache can never produce a false no-op.
A missing, stopped, or unhealthy container with a recorded image is config-only: update recreates the recorded image without Railpack or BuildKit.
Running-image drift from the recorded current image is an unknown difference and therefore a rebuild.

Secret-file changes are detected through an optional merged-environment snapshot; only variable names are reported, never values. An incomplete snapshot is treated as an unknown difference and rebuilt.
The diff accepts narrow UpdateRecordedState and UpdateContainerObservation shapes so AppState and ContainerInspect satisfy them structurally without a Podman import.
interfaces: UpdateDiffInput, UpdateDiff, UpdateChange, UpdateRecordedState, UpdateContainerObservation, UpdateEnvironmentSnapshot, UpdateDiffKind, UpdateContainerStatus, UpdateStateStatus
validationLimitations: No Podman, git, filesystem, or registry I/O is involved in this module by design; only the gated update integration suite (UPD-1.4, owned by qa-engineer) can prove the later swap path on a real host.
payload.taskDescription: Implement diff.ts comparing the persisted config and state with the desired config. Return no-op when nothing changed and the container is running and healthy; config-only for env, secrets, bind, host port, container port, health settings, and volume changes; rebuild for repo, ref, local-path changes and for --rebuild. Treat unknown differences as rebuild. Tests cover each field, a combined config-only change, a combined rebuild change, the force flag, a missing state file, and an app whose container is missing.
